# NOTE: `hiperf list` here carries only the measured hardware section; the
# software-event section was not captured on this device, so no names are invented.
param get const.product.cpu.abilist	arm64-v8a
param get const.product.name	HUAWEI Mate 60
param get const.product.software.version	BRA-AL00 7.0.0.111(SP10C00E111R4P3)
param get const.ohos.fullname	OpenHarmony-7.0.0.111
param get const.product.devicetype	phone
which hiprofiler_cmd	/bin/hiprofiler_cmd
which hiperf	/bin/hiperf
which hitrace	/bin/hitrace
which hidumper	/bin/hidumper
which uitest	/bin/uitest
hiperf list hw	Supported events for hardware:\n	hw-cpu-cycles\n	hw-instructions\n	hw-cache-references\n	hw-cache-misses\n	hw-branch-instructions\n	hw-branch-misses\n	hw-bus-cycles\n	hw-stalled-cycles-frontend\n	hw-stalled-cycles-backend\n
hiperf list	Supported events for hardware:\n	hw-cpu-cycles\n	hw-instructions\n	hw-cache-references\n	hw-cache-misses\n	hw-branch-instructions\n	hw-branch-misses\n	hw-bus-cycles\n	hw-stalled-cycles-frontend\n	hw-stalled-cycles-backend\n
